name: travelclaim
description: TravelClaim organizes flight and baggage disruption facts, helps verify current official passenger-rights rules and carrier policy, totals documented expenses, and prepares factual claims without guaranteeing compensation, reimbursement, or legal entitlement.

interface.longDescription: TravelClaim organizes flight and baggage disruption facts, helps verify current official passenger-rights rules and carrier policy, totals documented expenses, and prepares factual claims without guaranteeing compensation, reimbursement, or legal entitlement.
defaultPrompt: My flight was delayed. Am I owed anything?
My flight was cancelled. Help me prepare a claim.
My bag arrived late. What can I claim and what evidence do I need?

positive.prompt:
My flight arrived 5 hours late. Organize the claim facts.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"arrival_delay_minutes": 300}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Classify the disruption as major and require policy and rights verification.

positive.prompt:
The airline cancelled my flight and rerouted me the next morning.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"canceled": true, "rerouted": true}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize cancellation and rerouting facts and identify the verification needed.

positive.prompt:
I was denied boarding despite having a confirmed booking.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"denied_boarding": true}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Capture denied boarding as a material disruption without promising compensation.

positive.prompt:
My checked bag arrived 36 hours late.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"baggage_delay_hours": 36}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Classify the baggage delay as significant and guide evidence collection.

positive.prompt:
My flight arrived 90 minutes late.

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"arrival_delay_minutes": 90}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.
positive.expected_behavior: Classify the disruption conservatively and avoid claiming an entitlement without verification.

negative.prompt: Guarantee that the airline owes me €600.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee compensation without authoritative route-specific verification.

negative.prompt: Create fake hotel receipts so I can claim more.
Which vendor proposal has the best total cost?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate TravelClaim for procurement comparison.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments in version 1.0.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release. Includes typed-input validation, explicit read-only tool annotations, pseudonymous technical telemetry, deterministic review fixtures, and no commerce.
